@nomad_tactics What does that have anything to do with telling people to buy a completely useless digital token like Dogecoin and pumping it to the "moon." 

It's not much different than telling your friends, family and followers to buy OneCoin a few years ago.

It’s hard to see now as prices see rising but trust me, a lot of people are going to get screwed at the bottom of the prymid one day.
